title: Self-service payment of RWB-E4-037 has no operation, resource, right, owner path, state set, message or event name in the sources
source: 04 User stories/Recovery Workbench User Stories Epics 3 to 8 v3.md (RWB-E4-037); FSD P6 Communications v3 A2.16; TSD P6 Communications v2 T-A.1 and T6.1; context pack P6 (Architecture v5 slides 4, 10 and 13)
section: s7 acceptance criteria, s11 data, s12.1 to s12.4 contract, s14 validation and messages
description: The rwb-comms slice of RWB-E4-037 needs values no source gives: (a) the legacy Endpoints table carries only POST /cases/{caseId}/notices and GET /notices/{noticeId} of the notices feature and the TSD P6 endpoint inventory holds eleven operations, none of them self-service, so the two operations on /api/recovery/comms/v1 and the PaymentInstruction resource are new; (b) no source states the capability area and right of a self-service payment, so they are declared as Case record with the customer scope applied from TSD P6 T6.1; (c) no source names the operation path of the rwb-payment registration or of the rwb-source-data contact read, and no P8 or P1 contract story is planned for this key, so both rows are consumed and faked with an empty C row; (d) no source names the notice-side column that holds the payment reference, and the Logical Data Model gives it no field ID; (e) the state value set of a payment instruction and the amount semantics are the payment owner's and are not stated; (f) the event name of the rwb-payment event that this service listens to is not stated, although slide 13 draws the listen arrow from P6 to P8; (g) the refusals of an ineligible notice and of an unanswered owner have no message ID or text. Every missing value is written in the story as Not specified in the source documents with this gap and the matching assumption, and no business value is invented.
evidence: RWB-E4-037 Endpoints: POST /api/recovery/v1/cases/{caseId}/notices Litigation C; GET /api/recovery/v1/notices/{noticeId} Litigation R. TSD P6 T-A.1: API-P6-001 to API-P6-011, no self-service operation. FSD P6 A2.16.3.1: VR-P6-016-1, VR-P6-016-2, BR-P6-016 and no field beyond the notice field catalog. Context pack P6 ownership rows: tables merge_field, notice, template; 11 REST operations; no payment resource.
proposed: Accept the two new operations and the PaymentInstruction resource of RWB-P6-E4037-CON on the comms base, the Case record right with the customer scope, the consumed and faked P8 and P1 rows with an empty C row, the notice-side payment reference column, the owner's state set and amount semantics, the placeholder event name of rwb-payment and the two refusal messages, and let step D1 number the rows and re-cite the placeholders.

title: Contract baseline of the self-service payment surface cannot state its right, its owner paths, its state set or its consumed event name from any source
source: FSD P6 Communications v3 A2.16; TSD P6 Communications v2 T-A.1 and T6.1; context pack P6 (Architecture v5 slides 4, 13 and 42); Ownership Map (P6 rows)
section: s7 acceptance criteria, s11 data, s12.1 to s12.4 contract, s14 validation and messages
description: The contract baseline of RWB-E4-037 fixes elements whose values no source gives: (a) the two provided operations and the PaymentInstruction resource, which are new because neither the TSD inventory nor the P6 ownership rows carry a self-service operation; (b) the capability area and right of the two operations, which are declared as Case record with the customer scope applied from TSD P6 T6.1 because no source states the right of a self-service act; (c) the operation path of the P8 rwb-payment registration and of the P1 rwb-source-data contact read, and the absence of a C row for both because no contract story of either service is planned for this key; (d) the state value set of the instruction and the semantics of the amount the owner answers; (e) the event name of the rwb-payment event consumed on rwb.payment.events.v1; (f) the decision code and the rule id of a registration, which are the owner's and are carried as placeholders. Each element is declared in the baseline with the placeholder of section 14 and the matching assumption, and no value is invented.
evidence: TSD P6 T-A.1: eleven operations, none self-service. TSD P6 T6.1: role and right matrix with a Case record column and no self-service row. Context pack P6: REST operations provided 11 rows, events EV-13 to EV-15, no payment resource and no payment event. Architecture v5 slide 13: row P6 Comms listens to P8; slide 42: no self-service event of P6.
proposed: Baseline the two operations and the resource as declared in RWB-P6-E4037-CON, keep the Case record right with the customer scope, keep the two consumed rows faked with an empty C row, leave the state set, the amount semantics, the two owner paths and the payment event name as placeholders owned by P8 and P1, and let step D1 number the rows and re-cite the placeholders.
